title: Chisco

funding_references.funder_name: National Natural Science Foundation of China

description: Chisco is a Chinese imagined speech EEG dataset (version 1.0) comprising recordings from five participants across multiple sessions. The dataset includes both raw EEG data in EDF format and preprocessed data in fif and pkl formats, along with associated text stimuli used during data collection. This resource supports research in brain-computer interfaces and neural decoding of imagined speech. Note: Data from sub-01 to sub-03 follow BIDS 1.6.0, while supplementary data from sub-04 and sub-05 follow an earlier BIDS protocol version to maintain consistency with published data processing code.
methods_description: EEG data were collected from five participants (sub-01 to sub-05) over 5-6 sessions per participant. Raw data are provided in EDF format, with preprocessed derivatives available in both fif and pkl formats. Text stimuli used to elicit imagined speech responses are included in the dataset. Data from sub-01 to sub-03 adhere to BIDS 1.6.0, while supplementary data from sub-04 and sub-05 follow an earlier BIDS protocol version.
